limitations: Associations are descriptive and ecological, not causal or individual-level.
The primary sample contains only 37 sections.
Current predictors aggregated to 28 historical families are a sensitivity, not contemporaneous historical covariates.
The 32-family growth and 41-section 2026 universes are not mixed with the primary model.
P-values and intervals use asymptotic correlation approximations; effect size and sensitivity receive priority.
No heavy statistical or plotting dependencies are required.
